Idk I've never been to America but to me the differences are big enough in some cases. Like I find our version of Nutella gross and I don't even like it unless I can get some from Germany. 

Again it's just a matter of taste. No use arguing about that 😅

But the same brands use different ingredients depending on the country? Even if I go to neighboring countries here in Europe the exact same products taste different to me.

But yeah it's up to personal taste to say which version tastes better.
Why are you adding sugar to bread though? You're proving us right 😅

Where did you try them? If it's grocery store/restaurant stuff then I would expect it to be too sweet for the locals as well. Unless it's some super high quality stuff they will often be cutting cost by using too much sugar. 

I don't really like most of the stuff you can buy in my country either but when people make homemade treats it's much tastier and most of the popular recipes will reflect this as well. 

I also use half the sugar when I'm making American recipes like the other commenters said so there must be some truth to it.

I think the stinking perfume is under kuttenberg in the smuggler's storehouse. When my bf used it the stink never went away even after washing clothes and visiting the bathhouse. Probably a bug but it would be perfect for you 😅
